name: Faraday
description: Collaborative vulnerability management platform that consolidates output from many security scanners into one workspace.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PGSQL_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      PGSQL_USER: {{env.PGSQL_USER}}
      PGSQL_PASSWD: {{env.PGSQL_PASSWD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/home/faraday/.faraday
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: faraday
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.PGSQL_PASSWD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: faraday
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
